  def initialize(capacity : Int32)
    @elem = Array(T).new(capacity)
  end

  def initialize(list : Enumerable(T))
    @elem = list.to_a
    1.upto(size - 1) { |i| fixup(i) }
  end

  def size
    @elem.size
  end

  def add(v)
    @elem << v
    fixup(size - 1)
  end

  def top
    @elem[0]
  end

  def pop
    ret = @elem[0]
    last = @elem.pop
    if size > 0
      @elem[0] = last
      fixdown(0)
    end
    ret
  end

  def decrease_top(new_value : T)
    @elem[0] = new_value
    fixdown(0)
  end

  def to_s(io : IO)
    io << @elem
  end

  private def fixup(index : Int32)
    while index > 0
      parent = (index - 1) / 2
      break if @elem[parent] >= @elem[index]
      @elem[parent], @elem[index] = @elem[index], @elem[parent]
      index = parent
    end
  end

  private def fixdown(index : Int32)
    while true
      left = index * 2 + 1
      break if left >= size
      if @elem[left] > @elem[index]
        @elem[left], @elem[index] = @elem[index], @elem[left]
        index = left
        next
      end
      right = index * 2 + 2
      break if right >= size
      if @elem[right] > @elem[index]
        @elem[right], @elem[index] = @elem[index], @elem[right]
        index = right
        next
      end
      break
    end
  end
end

  s = Array(Int64).new(n + 1, -1_i64)
  init = a[0, n]
  s[0] = init.sum
  q = PriorityQueue.new(init)

  s

      fixdown(0)
    end

  end

    @elem[0] = new_value
    fixdown(0)
  end

  end

      @elem[parent], @elem[index] = @elem[index], @elem[parent]
      index = parent
    end
  end

    while true
      left = index * 2 + 1

  end

	for i in range(N):
		right[i] *= -1

	left_sum = 0
	right_sum = 0

	heap_left = []
	heap_right = []

	for i in range(N):
		left_sum += left[i]
		heapq.heappush(heap_left, left[i])
		right_sum += right[i]
		heapq.heappush(heap_right, right[i])

	temp2 = [0] * (N + 1)

	temp2[N] = right_sum

		heapq.heappush(heap_left, a[N+i])

		heapq.heappush(heap_right, -a[N*2-1-i])

	ans = -1000000000
	for i in range(0, N + 1):

local mma = math.max
local mfl, mce, mmi = math.floor, math.ceil, math.min

local AvlTree = {}
AvlTree.makenode = function(self, val, parent)
  local i = self.box[#self.box]
  table.remove(self.box)
  self.v[i], self.p[i] = val, parent
  self.lc[i], self.rc[i], self.l[i], self.r[i] = 0, 0, 1, 1
  return i
end
AvlTree.create = function(self, lessthan, n)
  self.lessthan = lessthan
  self.root = 1
  self.box = {}
  for i = n + 1, 2, -1 do table.insert(self.box, i) end
  -- value, leftCount, rightCount, left, right, parent
  self.v, self.lc, self.rc, self.l, self.r, self.p = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  for i = 1, n + 1 do
    self.v[i], self.p[i] = 0, 1
    self.lc[i], self.rc[i], self.l[i], self.r[i] = 0, 0, 1, 1
  end
end

AvlTree.recalcCount = function(self, i)
  if 1 < i then
    local kl, kr = self.l[i], self.r[i]
    if 1 < kl then self.lc[i] = 1 + mma(self.lc[kl], self.rc[kl])
    else self.lc[i] = 0
    end
    if 1 < kr then self.rc[i] = 1 + mma(self.lc[kr], self.rc[kr])
    else self.rc[i] = 0
    end
  end
end
AvlTree.recalcCountAll = function(self, i)
  while 1 < i do
    self:recalcCount(i)
    i = self.p[i]
  end
end

AvlTree.rotR = function(self, child, parent)
  local granp = self.p[parent]
  self.r[child], self.l[parent] = parent, self.r[child]
  self.p[child], self.p[parent] = granp, child
  self.p[self.l[parent]] = parent
  if 1 < granp then
    if self.l[granp] == parent then
      self.l[granp] = child
    else
      self.r[granp] = child
    end
  else
    self.root = child
  end
  self:recalcCountAll(parent)
end

AvlTree.rotL = function(self, child, parent)
  local granp = self.p[parent]
  self.l[child], self.r[parent] = parent, self.l[child]
  self.p[child], self.p[parent] = granp, child
  self.p[self.r[parent]] = parent
  if 1 < granp then
    if self.r[granp] == parent then
      self.r[granp] = child
    else
      self.l[granp] = child
    end
  else
    self.root = child
  end
  self:recalcCountAll(parent)
end

AvlTree.add = function(self, val)
  if self.root <= 1 then self.root = self:makenode(val, 1) return end
  local pos = self.root
  while true do
    if self.lessthan(val, self.v[pos]) then
      if 1 < self.l[pos] then
        pos = self.l[pos]
      else
        self.l[pos] = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = self.l[pos]
        break
      end
    else
      if 1 < self.r[pos] then
        pos = self.r[pos]
      else
        self.r[pos] = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = self.r[pos]
        break
      end
    end
  end
  while 1 < pos do
    local child, parent = pos, self.p[pos]
    if parent <= 1 then
      break
    end
    self:recalcCount(parent)
    if self.l[parent] == child then
      if self.lc[parent] - 1 == self.rc[parent] then
        pos = parent
      elseif self.lc[parent] - 2 == self.rc[parent] then
        if self.lc[child] - 1 == self.rc[child] then
          self:rotR(child, parent)
        else
          local cr = self.r[child]
          self:rotL(cr, child)
          self:rotR(cr, parent)
        end
        pos = 1
      else
        self:recalcCountAll(child)
        pos = 1
      end
    else -- parent.r == child
      if self.rc[parent] - 1 == self.lc[parent] then
        pos = parent
      elseif self.rc[parent] - 2 == self.lc[parent] then
        if self.rc[child] - 1 == self.lc[child] then
          self:rotL(child, parent)
        else
          local cl = self.l[child]
          self:rotR(cl, child)
          self:rotL(cl, parent)
        end
        pos = 1
      else
        self:recalcCountAll(child)
        pos = 1
      end
    end
  end
end

AvlTree.rmsub = function(self, node)
  while 1 < node do
    self:recalcCount(node)
    if self.lc[node] == self.rc[node] then
      node = self.p[node]
    elseif self.lc[node] + 1 == self.rc[node] then
      self:recalcCountAll(self.p[node])
      node = 1
    else
      if self.lc[self.r[node]] == self.rc[self.r[node]] then
        self:rotL(self.r[node], node)
        node = 1
      elseif self.lc[self.r[node]] + 1 == self.rc[self.r[node]] then
        local nr = self.r[node]
        self:rotL(nr, node)
        node = nr
      else
        local nrl = self.l[self.r[node]]
        self:rotR(nrl, self.r[node])
        self:rotL(nrl, node)
        node = nrl
      end
    end
  end
end

AvlTree.pop = function(self)
  local node = self.root
  while 1 < self.l[node] do
    node = self.l[node]
  end
  local v = self.v[node]
  local kp = self.p[node]
  self.p[self.r[node]] = kp
  if 1 < kp then
    self.l[kp] = self.r[node]
    self:rmsub(kp)
  else
    self.root = self.r[node]
  end
  table.insert(self.box, node)
  return v
end

AvlTree.new = function(lessthan, n)
    local obj = {}
    setmetatable(obj, {__index = AvlTree})
    obj:create(lessthan, n)
    return obj
end

    end

AvlTree.add = function(self, val)
  if self.root <= 1 then self.root = self:makenode(val, 1) return end
  local pos = self.root
  while true do
    if self.lessthan(val, self.v[pos]) then
      if 1 < self.l[pos] then
        pos = self.l[pos]
      else
        self.l[pos] = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = self.l[pos]
        break
      end
    else
      if 1 < self.r[pos] then
        pos = self.r[pos]
      else
        self.r[pos] = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = self.r[pos]
        break
      end
    end
  end
  while 1 < pos do
    local child, parent = pos, self.p[pos]
    if parent <= 1 then
      break
    end
    self:recalcCount(parent)
    local lcp_m_rcp = self.lc[parent] - self.rc[parent]
    if lcp_m_rcp % 2 ~= 0 then -- 1 or -1
      pos = parent
    elseif lcp_m_rcp == 2 then
      if self.lc[child] - 1 == self.rc[child] then
        self:rotR(child, parent)
      else
        local cr = self.r[child]
        self:rotL(cr, child)
        self:rotR(cr, parent)
      end
      pos = 1
    elseif lcp_m_rcp == -2 then
      if self.rc[child] - 1 == self.lc[child] then
        self:rotL(child, parent)
      else
        local cl = self.l[child]
        self:rotR(cl, child)
        self:rotL(cl, parent)
      end
      pos = 1
    else
      -- self:recalcCountAll(child)
      pos = 1
    end
  end
end

AvlTree.rmsub = function(self, node)
  while 1 < node do
    self:recalcCount(node)
    if self.lc[node] == self.rc[node] then
      node = self.p[node]
    elseif self.lc[node] + 1 == self.rc[node] then
      self:recalcCountAll(self.p[node])
      node = 1
    else
      if self.lc[self.r[node]] == self.rc[self.r[node]] then
        self:rotL(self.r[node], node)
        node = 1
      elseif self.lc[self.r[node]] + 1 == self.rc[self.r[node]] then
        local nr = self.r[node]
        self:rotL(nr, node)
        node = nr
      else
        local nrl = self.l[self.r[node]]
        self:rotR(nrl, self.r[node])
        self:rotL(nrl, node)
        node = nrl
      end
    end
  end
end

AvlTree.pop = function(self)
  local node = self.root
  while 1 < self.l[node] do
    node = self.l[node]
  end
  local v = self.v[node]
  local kp = self.p[node]
  self.p[self.r[node]] = kp
  if 1 < kp then
    self.l[kp] = self.r[node]
    self:rmsub(kp)
  else
    self.root = self.r[node]
  end
  table.insert(self.box, node)
  return v
end

local SegTree = {}
SegTree.updateAll = function(self)
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    local cnt = bls(1, i - 1)
    for j = 1, cnt do
      self.stage[i][j] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][j * 2 - 1], self.stage[i + 1][j * 2])
    end
  end
end
SegTree.create = function(self, n, func, emptyvalue)
  self.func, self.emptyvalue = func, emptyvalue
  local stagenum, mul = 1, 1
  self.stage = {{}}
  while mul < n do
    mul, stagenum = mul * 2, stagenum + 1
    self.stage[stagenum] = {}
  end
  self.stagenum = stagenum
  self.left_stage = {}
  for i = 1, n do
    local sp, sz = 1, bls(1, stagenum - 1)
    while(i - 1) % sz ~= 0 do
      sp, sz = sp + 1, brs(sz, 1)
    end
    self.left_stage[i] = sp
  end
  self.sz_stage = {}
  local tmp, sp = 1, stagenum
  for i = 1, n do
    if tmp * 2 == i then tmp, sp = tmp * 2, sp - 1 end
    self.sz_stage[i] = sp
  end
  for i = 1, n do self.stage[stagenum][i] = i end
  for i = n + 1, mul do self.stage[stagenum][i] = emptyvalue end
  self:updateAll()
end
SegTree.getRange = function(self, left, right)
  if left == right then return self.stage[self.stagenum][left] end
  local stagenum = self.stagenum
  local ret = self.emptyvalue
  while left <= right do
    local stage = mma(self.left_stage[left], self.sz_stage[right - left + 1])
    local sz = bls(1, stagenum - stage)
    ret = self.func(ret, self.stage[stage][1 + brs(left - 1, stagenum - stage)])
    left = left + sz
  end
  return ret
end
SegTree.update = function(self, idx)
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    local dst = brs(idx + 1, 1)
    local rem = dst * 4 - 1 - idx
    self.stage[i][dst] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][idx], self.stage[i + 1][rem])
    idx = dst
  end
end
SegTree.setValue = function(self, idx, value, silent)
  self.stage[self.stagenum][idx] = value
  if not silent then
    self:update(idx)
  end
end
SegTree.new = function(n, func, emptyvalue)

  setmetatable(obj, {__index = SegTree})
  obj:create(n, func, emptyvalue)

end

    if node.l then node.lc = 1 + mma(node.l.lc, node.l.rc)
    else node.lc = 0
    end
    if node.r then node.rc = 1 + mma(node.r.lc, node.r.rc)
    else node.rc = 0

    self:recalcCount(node)
    node = node.p
  end
end

AvlTree.rotR = function(self, child, parent)
  local granp = parent.p
  child.r, parent.l = parent, child.r
  child.p, parent.p = granp, child
  if parent.l then parent.l.p = parent end
  if granp then
    if granp.l == parent then
      granp.l = child
    else
      granp.r = child
    end
  else -- granp == nil
    self.root = child
  end
  self:recalcCountAll(parent)
end

AvlTree.rotL = function(self, child, parent)
  local granp = parent.p
  child.l, parent.r = parent, child.l
  child.p, parent.p = granp, child
  if parent.r then parent.r.p = parent end
  if granp then
    if granp.r == parent then

    else

    if self.lessthan(val, pos.v) then
      if pos.l then
        pos = pos.l
      else
        pos.l = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = pos.l
        added = true
      end
    else
      if pos.r then
        pos = pos.r
      else
        pos.r = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = pos.r
        added = true
      end
    end
  end
  self:recalcCountAll(pos)
  local resolve_child = pos
  while resolve_child do
    local child, parent = resolve_child, resolve_child.p
    resolve_child = nil
    if not parent then
      break
    end
    if parent.l == child then
      if parent.lc - 1 == parent.rc then
        resolve_child = parent
      elseif parent.lc - 2 == parent.rc then
        if child.lc - 1 == child.rc then
          self:rotR(child, parent)
        else
          local cr = child.r
          self:rotL(cr, child)
          self:rotR(cr, parent)
        end
      end
    else -- parent.r == child
      if parent.rc - 1 == parent.lc then
        resolve_child = parent
      elseif parent.rc - 2 == parent.lc then
        if child.rc - 1 == child.lc then
          self:rotL(child, parent)
        else

          self:rotR(cl, child)

        end

    end
  end

AvlTree.rmsub = function(self, node)
  while node do
    self:recalcCount(node)
    if node.lc == node.rc then
      node = node.p
    elseif node.lc + 1 == node.rc then
      self:recalcCountAll(node.p)
      node = nil
    else
      if node.r.lc == node.r.rc then
        self:rotL(node.r, node)
        self:recalcCountAll(node)
        node = nil
      elseif node.r.lc + 1 == node.r.rc then
        local nr = node.r
        self:rotL(nr, node)
        node = nr
      else
        local nrl = node.r.l
        self:rotR(nrl, node.r)
        self:rotL(nrl, node)
        node = nrl
      end
    end
  end
end

AvlTree.pop = function(self)
  local edge = self.root
  while edge.l do
    edge = edge.l
  end
  local v = edge.v
  if edge.p then
    if edge.r then edge.r.p = edge.p end
    edge.p.l = edge.r
    self:rmsub(edge.p)
  else
    if edge.r then edge.r.p = nil end
    self.root = edge.r
  end
  return v
end

  self.cnt, self.stage, self.size = {1}, {{}}, {}
  while mul < #ary do
    mul, stagenum = mul * 2, stagenum + 1
    self.cnt[stagenum], self.stage[stagenum] = mul, {}
  end
  for i = 1, stagenum do self.size[i] = self.cnt[stagenum + 1 - i] end
  self.stagenum = stagenum
  for i = 1, #ary do self.stage[stagenum][i] = ary[i] end
  for i = #ary + 1, mul do self.stage[stagenum][i] = emptyvalue end
  self:updateAll()
end
SegTree.addValue = function(self, idx, val)
  self.stage[self.stagenum][idx] = self.stage[self.stagenum][idx] + val
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    local dst = mce(idx / 2)
    local rem = dst * 4 - 1 - idx
    self.stage[i][dst] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][idx], self.stage[i + 1][rem])
    idx = dst
  end
end
SegTree.new = function(ary, func, emptyvalue)
  local obj = {}
  setmetatable(obj, {__index = SegTree})
  obj:create(ary, func, emptyvalue)
  return obj
end

SegTree.takeLeft = function(self)
  local ret, retpos = self.emptyvalue, 0
  local t1, t2, t3 = {1}, {1}, {self.size[1]}
  while 0 < #t1 do
    local stage, l, r = t1[#t1], t2[#t1], t3[#t1]
    table.remove(t1) table.remove(t2) table.remove(t3)
    local sz = self.size[stage]
    if sz <= r + 1 - l then
      local tmp = self.func(ret, self.stage[stage][mce(l / sz)])
      if tmp < 1 then
        ret, retpos = tmp, l + sz - 1
        if sz ~= 1 then table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l + sz) table.insert(t3, r) end
      else
        if sz ~= 1 then table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l) table.insert(t3, l + sz - 2) end
      end
    else
      table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l) table.insert(t3, r)
    end
  end
  retpos = retpos + 1
  self:addValue(retpos, -1)
  return retpos
end

AvlTree.makenode = function(self, val, parent)
  local node = {}
  node.v, node.lc, node.rc = val, 0, 0
  node.p = parent
  -- node.l, node.r = nil, nil
  return node
end
AvlTree.create = function(self, lessthan)
  self.lessthan = lessthan
end

AvlTree.recalcCount = function(self, node)
  if node then
    if node.l then node.lc = 1 + mma(node.l.lc, node.l.rc)
    else node.lc = 0
    end
    if node.r then node.rc = 1 + mma(node.r.lc, node.r.rc)
    else node.rc = 0
    end
  end
end
AvlTree.recalcCountAll = function(self, node)
  while node do
    self:recalcCount(node)
    node = node.p
  end
end

AvlTree.rotR = function(self, child, parent)
  local granp = parent.p
  child.r, parent.l = parent, child.r
  child.p, parent.p = granp, child
  if parent.l then parent.l.p = parent end
  if granp then
    if granp.l == parent then
      granp.l = child
    else
      granp.r = child
    end
  else -- granp == nil
    self.root = child
  end
  self:recalcCountAll(parent)
end

AvlTree.rotL = function(self, child, parent)
  local granp = parent.p
  child.l, parent.r = parent, child.l
  child.p, parent.p = granp, child
  if parent.r then parent.r.p = parent end
  if granp then
    if granp.r == parent then
      granp.r = child
    else
      granp.l = child
    end
  else -- granp == nil
    self.root = child
  end
  self:recalcCountAll(parent)
end

AvlTree.add = function(self, val)
  if not self.root then self.root = self:makenode(val) return end
  local pos = self.root
  local added = false
  while not added do
    if self.lessthan(val, pos.v) then
      if pos.l then
        pos = pos.l
      else
        pos.l = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = pos.l
        added = true
      end
    else
      if pos.r then
        pos = pos.r
      else
        pos.r = self:makenode(val, pos)
        pos = pos.r
        added = true
      end
    end
  end
  while pos do
    local child, parent = pos, pos.p
    if not parent then
      break
    end
    self:recalcCount(child)
    self:recalcCount(parent)
    if parent.l == child then
      if parent.lc - 1 == parent.rc then
        pos = parent
      elseif parent.lc - 2 == parent.rc then
        if child.lc - 1 == child.rc then
          self:rotR(child, parent)
        else
          local cr = child.r
          self:rotL(cr, child)
          self:rotR(cr, parent)
        end
        self:recalcCountAll(child)
        pos = nil
      else
        self:recalcCountAll(child)
        pos = nil
      end
    else -- parent.r == child
      if parent.rc - 1 == parent.lc then
        pos = parent
      elseif parent.rc - 2 == parent.lc then
        if child.rc - 1 == child.lc then
          self:rotL(child, parent)
        else
          local cl = child.l
          self:rotR(cl, child)
          self:rotL(cl, parent)
        end
        self:recalcCountAll(child)
        pos = nil
      else
        self:recalcCountAll(child)
        pos = nil
      end
    end
  end
end

AvlTree.rmsub = function(self, node)
  while node do
    self:recalcCount(node)
    if node.lc == node.rc then
      node = node.p
    elseif node.lc + 1 == node.rc then
      self:recalcCountAll(node.p)
      node = nil
    else
      if node.r.lc == node.r.rc then
        self:rotL(node.r, node)
        self:recalcCountAll(node)
        node = nil
      elseif node.r.lc + 1 == node.r.rc then
        local nr = node.r
        self:rotL(nr, node)
        node = nr
      else
        local nrl = node.r.l
        self:rotR(nrl, node.r)
        self:rotL(nrl, node)
        node = nrl
      end
    end
  end
end

AvlTree.pop = function(self)
  local edge = self.root
  while edge.l do
    edge = edge.l
  end
  local v = edge.v
  if edge.p then
    if edge.r then edge.r.p = edge.p end
    edge.p.l = edge.r
    self:rmsub(edge.p)
  else
    if edge.r then edge.r.p = nil end
    self.root = edge.r
  end
  return v
end

AvlTree.new = function(lessthan)
    local obj = {}
    setmetatable(obj, {__index = AvlTree})
    obj:create(lessthan)
    return obj
end

AvlTree.rotR = function(self, child, parent)

  if parent.l then parent.l.p = parent end
  if granp then

  else -- granp == nil

  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do

  end
  for i = 1, stagenum do self.size[i] = self.cnt[stagenum + 1 - i] end

  self.stage[self.stagenum][idx] = false
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    local dst = mce(idx / 2)
    local rem = dst * 4 - 1 - idx
    self.stage[i][dst] = segavl_mergefunc(self.stage[i + 1][idx], self.stage[i + 1][rem])

  end

  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do

search a@(x:xs) fc sc d f s lim

-- Heap
data SkewHeap a = Empty | Node a (SkewHeap a) (SkewHeap a)
            deriving (Show, Read, Eq)

singleton :: a -> SkewHeap a
singleton x = Node x Empty Empty

(+<+) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a
Empty               +<+ t2                  = t2
t1                  +<+ Empty               = t1
t1@(Node x1 l1 r1)  +<+ t2@(Node x2 l2 r2)
   | x1 <= x2   = Node x1 (t2 +<+ r1) l1
   | otherwise  = Node x2 (t1 +<+ r2) l2

(+>+) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a
Empty               +>+ t2                  = t2
t1                  +>+ Empty               = t1
t1@(Node x1 l1 r1)  +>+ t2@(Node x2 l2 r2)
   | x1 >= x2   = Node x1 (t2 +>+ r1) l1
   | otherwise  = Node x2 (t1 +>+ r2) l2

(+<) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
heap +< x = singleton x +<+ heap

(+>) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
heap +> x = singleton x +>+ heap

popMin :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> (Maybe a, SkewHeap a)
popMin Empty        = (Nothing, Empty)
popMin (Node x l r) = (Just x, l +<+ r)

popMax :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> (Maybe a, SkewHeap a)
popMax Empty        = (Nothing, Empty)
popMax (Node x l r) = (Just x, l +>+ r)

fromListMin :: Ord a => [a] -> SkewHeap a
fromListMin = foldl (+<) Empty

fromListMax :: Ord a => [a] -> SkewHeap a
fromListMax = foldl (+>) Empty

(-<-) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
(-<-) heap x = snd . popMin $ heap +< x

(->-) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
(->-) heap x = snd . popMax $ heap +> x

instance Foldable SkewHeap where
    foldMap _ Empty = mempty
    foldMap f (Node x l r) = foldMap f l `mappend` f x `mappend` foldMap f r

-- bag

type Bag = M.Map Int Int

findMin :: Bag -> Int
findMin bag = fst $ M.findMin bag

findMax :: Bag -> Int
findMax bag = fst $ M.findMax bag

delete :: Int -> Bag -> Bag
delete element bag = newbag
  where quantity = fromMaybe (-1) $ M.lookup element bag
        newbag = if quantity == -1 then bag
                    else if quantity > 1 then M.insertWith (flip (-)) element 1 bag
                            else M.delete element bag

insert :: Int -> Bag -> Bag
insert element bag = M.insertWith (+) element 1 bag

fromList :: [Int] -> Bag
fromList xs = M.fromList $ zip xs (replicate (length xs) 1)
-----------------------------------------------------

sum_large_n :: Bag -> Int -> Int
sum_large_n _ 0 = 0
sum_large_n bag n = (largest + sum_large_n newbag (n - 1))
  where largest = findMax bag
        newbag = delete largest bag

sum_small_n :: Bag -> Int -> Int
sum_small_n _ 0 = 0
sum_small_n bag n = smallest + sum_small_n newbag (n - 1)
  where smallest = findMin bag
        newbag = delete smallest bag


iterate_l :: Int -> [Int] -> Bag -> [Int]
iterate_l _ [] _ = []
iterate_l n (x:xs) bag = ans:iterate_l n xs newbag
  where ans = sum_large_n newbag n
        newbag = insert x bag

iterate_r :: Int -> [Int] -> Bag -> [Int]
iterate_r _ [] _ = []
iterate_r n (x:xs) bag = ans:iterate_r n xs newbag
  where ans = sum_small_n newbag n
        newbag = insert x bag

type Fst_count = Int
type Snd_count = Int
type Dropped = Int
type Fst = Int
type Snd = Int
type Limit = Int
search :: [Int] -> Fst_count -> Snd_count -> Dropped -> Fst -> Snd -> Limit -> Int
search a@(x:xs) fc sc d f s lim
  | fc == lim && sc == lim = f - s
  | fc /= lim = if d /= lim then max (search xs fc sc (d + 1) f s lim) (search xs (fc + 1) sc d (f + x) s lim) else search xs (fc + 1) sc d (f + x) s lim
  | sc /= lim = if d /= lim then max (search xs fc sc (d + 1) f s lim) (search xs fc (sc + 1) d f (s + x) lim) else (f - (s + sum a))

solve :: Int -> [Int] -> Int
solve n as = maximum $ zipWith (-) y1s y2s
  where
    (a1s,bs,a2s) = split3 as n
    y1s = map (F.foldl1 (+)) $ scanl (-<-) (fromListMin a1s) (reverse bs)
    y2s = map (F.foldl1 (+)) $ scanr (flip (->-)) (fromListMax a2s) bs

split3 :: [a] -> Int -> ([a], [a], [a])
split3 zs n = (xs,ys,zs'')
  where
    (xs, zs') = split2 ([], zs) n
    (ys, zs'') = split2 ([], zs') n

split2 :: ([a], [a]) -> Int -> ([a], [a])
split2 (_,[]) _ = undefined
split2 (xs,ys) 0 = (xs,ys)
split2 (xs,y0:ys) n = split2 (y0:xs,ys) (n - 1)

-- Heap
data SkewHeap a = Empty | Node a (SkewHeap a) (SkewHeap a)
            deriving (Show, Read, Eq)

singleton :: a -> SkewHeap a
singleton x = Node x Empty Empty

(+<+) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a
Empty               +<+ t2                  = t2
t1                  +<+ Empty               = t1
t1@(Node x1 l1 r1)  +<+ t2@(Node x2 l2 r2)
   | x1 <= x2   = Node x1 (t2 +<+ r1) l1
   | otherwise  = Node x2 (t1 +<+ r2) l2

(+>+) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a
Empty               +>+ t2                  = t2
t1                  +>+ Empty               = t1
t1@(Node x1 l1 r1)  +>+ t2@(Node x2 l2 r2)
   | x1 >= x2   = Node x1 (t2 +>+ r1) l1
   | otherwise  = Node x2 (t1 +>+ r2) l2

(+<) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
heap +< x = singleton x +<+ heap

(+>) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
heap +> x = singleton x +>+ heap

popMin :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> (Maybe a, SkewHeap a)
popMin Empty        = (Nothing, Empty)
popMin (Node x l r) = (Just x, l +<+ r)

popMax :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> (Maybe a, SkewHeap a)
popMax Empty        = (Nothing, Empty)
popMax (Node x l r) = (Just x, l +>+ r)

fromListMin :: Ord a => [a] -> SkewHeap a
fromListMin = foldl (+<) Empty

fromListMax :: Ord a => [a] -> SkewHeap a
fromListMax = foldl (+>) Empty

(-<-) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
(-<-) heap x = snd . popMin $ heap +< x

(->-) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
(->-) heap x = snd . popMax $ heap +> x

instance Foldable SkewHeap where
    foldMap _ Empty = mempty
    foldMap f (Node x l r) = foldMap f l `mappend` f x `mappend` foldMap f r

data SkewHeap a = Empty | Node !a (SkewHeap a) (SkewHeap a)
            deriving (Show, Read, Eq)

singleton :: a -> SkewHeap a
singleton x = Node x Empty Empty

(+@+) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a
Empty               +@+ t2                  = t2
t1                  +@+ Empty               = t1
t1@(Node x1 l1 r1)  +@+ t2@(Node x2 l2 r2)
   | x1 <= x2   = Node x1 (t2 +@+ r1) l1
   | otherwise  = Node x2 (t1 +@+ r2) l2

push :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
heap `push` x = singleton x +@+ heap

pop :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> (a, SkewHeap a)
pop Empty         = undefined
pop (Node x l r)  = (x, l +@+ r)

pushpop :: (Num a, Ord a) => a -> (a, SkewHeap a) -> (a, SkewHeap a)
x `pushpop` (y, h) = (y + x - x', h')
  where (x', h') = pop $ push h x

data SkewHeap a = Empty | Node !a !(SkewHeap a) !(SkewHeap a)
            deriving (Show, Read, Eq)

singleton :: a -> SkewHeap a
singleton x = Node x Empty Empty

(+@+) :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a -> SkewHeap a
Empty               +@+ t2                  = t2
t1                  +@+ Empty               = t1
t1@(Node x1 l1 r1)  +@+ t2@(Node x2 l2 r2)
   | x1 <= x2   = Node x1 (t2 +@+ r1) l1
   | otherwise  = Node x2 (t1 +@+ r2) l2

push :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> a -> SkewHeap a
heap `push` x = singleton x +@+ heap

pop :: Ord a => SkewHeap a -> (a, SkewHeap a)
pop Empty         = undefined
pop (Node x l r)  = (x, l +@+ r)

pushpop :: (Num a, Ord a) => a -> (a, SkewHeap a) -> (a, SkewHeap a)
x `pushpop` (y, h) = (y + x - x', h')
  where (x', h') = pop $ push h x

-- >>> solve 2 [3,1,4,1,5,9]
-- 1
--
-- >>> solve 1 [1,2,3]
-- -1
--
-- >>> solve 3 [8,2,2,7,4,6,5,3,8]
-- 5
solve :: Int -> [Int] -> Int
solve n as = maximum $ zipWith diff y1s y2s
  where
    diff (lh,_) (rh,_) = lh - negate rh
    (a1s, cs) = splitAt n as
    (bs, a2s) = splitAt n cs
    q1 = foldl push Empty a1s
    q2 = foldl push Empty (map negate a2s)
    lh0 = sum a1s
    rh0 = negate $ sum a2s
    y1s = scanl (flip pushpop) (lh0,q1) bs
    y2s = scanr pushpop (rh0,q2) (map negate bs)

n3 n as = maximum (fsearch n q1 (zip as2 [0..]) q2)
 where
  (as1,as2) = splitAt n as
  q1 = S.fromList (zip as1 [0..])
  q2 = S.fromList (zip as2 [0..])

fsearch n q1 ais q2 = do
 k <- [0..n]
 let (rh,rl) = transfer (n-k) k (rh0,q1) ais (rl0,q2)
 return (rh - rl)
  where
    rh0 = sum (map fst (S.elems q1))
    rl0 = sum (map fst (S.elems q2))

transfer n' 0 (rh,_) _ (rl,q2) = let (rl',_) = apply n' delmax (rl,q2) in (rh,rl')
 where
  delmax (m,q) = let ((vmax,_),q') = S.deleteFindMax q in (m-vmax,q')

transfer n' k (rh,q1) ((a,i2):ais) (rl,q2) = transfer n' (k-1) (rh-vmin+a, S.insert (a,i1) q1') ais (rl-a,q2')
 where
  ((vmin,i1),q1') = S.deleteFindMin q1
  q2' = S.delete (a,i2) q2

tupInsert :: Int -> (Int,Int) -> (Int,Int,Int)
tupInsert !z (!x,!y)
  | z < x     = force (z,x,y)
  | z < y     = force (x,z,y)
  | otherwise = force (x,y,z)

intoThree :: Int -> Int -> (Int,Int,Int)
intoThree !h !w = minimumBy (compare `on` (\(!s0,!s1,!s2) -> s2-s0)) $ do
  (!x,!y) <- [(h,w), (w,h)]
  let !xd3 = x `div` 3
  !x0 <- [max 0 $ xd3 - 3 .. min x $ xd3 + 4]
  return $! tupInsert (x0 * y) $ intoTwo (x - x0) y
  
intoTwo :: Int -> Int -> (Int,Int)
intoTwo !h !w
  | h > w     = go h w
  | otherwise = go w h
  where
    go !long !short
      | even short = force (halfarea,halfarea)
      | otherwise  = force (short * halflong, short * (long - halflong))
      where halflong = long `shiftR` 1
            halfarea = (long*short) `shiftR` 1

	for i in 2:length(a)

	end

function hpush(h::Array{Int,1},x)
	push!(h,x)
	l = length(h)
	if l>1
		k = div(l,2)
		while h[k]>x&&k>=1
			tmp = h[k]
			h[k] = x
			h[l] = tmp
			k = max(div(k,2),1)
			l = div(l,2)
		end
	end
end

function hpop(h::Array{Int,1})
	x = h[1]
	z = pop!(h)
	if !isempty(h)
		h[1] = z
		k = 1
		l = length(h)
		while k <= l
			if 2*k>=l
				break
			elseif 2*k+1>=l
				if h[2*k]>=z
					break
				else
					tmp = h[2*k]
					h[2*k] = z
					h[k] = tmp
					k = 2*k
				end
			else
				if h[2*k]>=z&&h[2*k+1]>=z
					break

					t = h[2*k]<h[2*k+1]?2*k:2*k+1
					tmp = h[t]
					h[t] = z
					h[k] = tmp
					k = t
				end
			end
		end
	end
	x
end

function hpush(h::Array{Int,1},x)
	push!(h,x)
	l = length(h)
	if l>1
		k = div(l,2)
		while h[k]>x&&k>=1
			tmp = h[k]
			h[k] = x
			h[l] = tmp
			k = max(div(k,2),1)
			l = div(l,2)
		end
	end

function hpop(h::Array{Int,1})
	x = h[1]

		while k <= l

/// 必要に応じてヒープと合計値を更新する。更新は O(log n) で行う。

    // 上位 n 項の最小値より真に大きいということは、
    // 追加される値が新たな上位 n 項に加わり、最小値が抜けるということ。

    if x > min then
      heap.Dequeue() |> ignore
      heap.Enqueue(x)
      sum <- sum - min + x

  member this.ToSeq() =
    heap.AsList :> seq<_>

  let mutable sum = sum

  let removed = MultiValueSet<_>.Empty()

  member this.Sum = sum

  member this.Remove(x) =
    if smalls.Remove(x) then
      let y =
        let rec loop () =
          let y = larges.Dequeue()
          if removed.Remove(y) then
            loop ()
          else
            y
        loop ()
      smalls.Add(y)
      sum <- sum - x + y
    else
      removed.Add(x)

  member this.ToSeq() =
    smalls.ToArray() :> seq<_>

class Heap
  attr_accessor :data, :size

  def initialize
    @data=[]
  end

  def comp(l, r)
    l < r
  end

  def push(e)
    @data.push(e)

    cur = @data.size-1
    return if cur.zero?
    parent_i = parent(cur)

    while cur > 0 && comp(e, @data[parent_i])
      parent = @data[parent_i]
      @data[parent_i] = e
      @data[cur] = parent
      cur = parent_i
      parent_i = parent(cur)
    end
  end

  def pop
    ret = @data.first
    last = data.last

    cur = 0
    while left_i(cur)<data.size
      li = left_i(cur)
      ri = right_i(cur)
      l=data[li]
      r=data[ri]
      ni=li
      ni=ri if r && comp(r, l)

      break if @data[ni] >= last

      @data[cur] = @data[ni]
      cur = ni
    end

    data[cur]=last
    data.pop

    ret
  end

  def left_i(i)
    2*i+1
  end

  def right_i(i)
    2*i+2
  end

  def parent(i)
    return 0 if i.zero?
    (i-1)/2
  end
end

class BH < Heap
  def comp(l,r)
    r > l
  end
end

class PQ
  attr_reader :heap, :sum

  def initialize(a)
    @heap = a.dup
    @sum = @heap.inject(0,:+)
    (@heap.size/2).downto(0){|i|
      sift_up(i)
    }
  end

  def sift_up(pos)
    last = @heap.size
    start = pos
    new_item = @heap[start]
    child = pos * 2 + 1
    while child < last
      right = child + 1
      child = right if right < last && @heap[child] >= @heap[right]
      @heap[pos] = @heap[child]
      pos = child
      child = pos * 2 + 1
    end
    @heap[pos] = new_item
    sift_down(start, pos)
  end

  def sift_down(start, pos)
    new_item = @heap[pos]
    while pos > start
      parent = (pos - 1) / 2
      parent_item = @heap[parent]
      break if new_item >= parent_item
      @heap[pos] = parent_item
      pos = parent
    end
    @heap[pos] = new_item
  end

  def [](i)
    @heap[i]
  end

  def to_a
    @heap
  end

  def empty?
    @heap.empty?
  end

  def push(item)
    @heap << item
    @sum += item
    sift_down(0, @heap.size-1)
    self
  end

  def <<(item)
    push(item)
  end

  def pop
    last_item = @heap.pop
    if @heap.empty?
      @sum -= last_item if last_item
      return last_item
    end
    res = @heap[0]
    @heap[0] = last_item
    sift_up(0)
    @sum -= res
    res
  end

  def push_pop(item)
    if @heap[0] < item
      @sum += item - heap[0]
      item, heap[0] = heap[0], item
      sift_up(0)
    end
    item
  end
end

  def initialize(&block)
    @elements = []

  end

      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p

    @elements[i] = n

      end
      @elements[i] = n
    end
    min
  end

      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p
    end
    @elements[i] = n

  end

class Heap
  attr_accessor :data, :size

  def initialize
    @data=[]
  end

  def push(e)
    @data.push(e)

    cur = @data.size-1
    return if cur.zero?
    parent_i = parent(cur)

    while cur > 0 && @data[cur] < @data[parent_i]
      parent = @data[parent_i]
      @data[parent_i] = e
      @data[cur] = parent
      cur = parent_i
      parent_i = parent(cur)
    end
  end

    ret = @data.first
    last = data.last

    cur = 0
    while left_i(cur)<data.size
      li = left_i(cur)
      ri = right_i(cur)
      l=data[li]
      r=data[ri]
      ni=li

      break if @data[ni] >= last

      @data[cur] = @data[ni]
      cur = ni
    end

    data[cur]=last
    data.pop

    ret
  end

  def left_i(i)
    2*i+1
  end

  def right_i(i)
    2*i+2
  end

  def parent(i)
    return 0 if i.zero?

  end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_accessor :data

  def initialize(arr=[])
    @data = arr
  end

  def push(e)
    @data.push(e)

    current_index = @data.size-1
    parent_index = parent(current_index)

    while current_index > 0 && @data[parent_index] > @data[current_index]
      @data[current_index] = @data[parent_index]
      @data[parent_index] = e
      current_index = parent_index
      parent_index = parent(current_index)
    end
  end

  def pop
    ret = @data.first
    last = @data.last
    current_index = 0

    while have_child?(current_index)
      li = left_child_index(current_index)
      ri = right_child_index(current_index)

      ni = li
      ni = ri if ri < @data.size && @data[ri] < @data[li]

      break if @data[ni] >= last

      @data[current_index] = @data[ni]
      current_index = ni
    end
    @data[current_index] = last
    @data.pop

    ret
  end

  def size
    @data.length
  end

  def parent(index)
    (index-1)/2
  end

  def left_child_index(index)
    2*index+1
  end

  def right_child_index(index)
    2*index+2
  end

  def have_child?(index)
    left_child_index(index) < @data.size
  end
end

class PriorityQueue
  def initialize
    @size = 0
    @heap = []
  end
  private
  def maxHeapify x
    l = 2*x
    r = 2*x+1
    if l <= @size && @heap[l][0] > @heap[x][0]
      largest = l
    else
      largest = x
    end
    if r <= @size && @heap[r][0] > @heap[largest][0]
      largest = r
    end
    if largest != x
      @heap[x], @heap[largest] = @heap[largest], @heap[x]
      maxHeapify(largest)
    end
  end

  public

  def pop
    data = @heap[1][1]
    @heap[1] = @heap[@size]
    @size -= 1
    maxHeapify(1)
    data
  end

  def push key,data
    @size += 1
    @heap[@size] = [key,data]
    i = @size
    while i > 1 && @heap[i/2][0] < @heap[i][0]
      @heap[i], @heap[i/2] = @heap[i/2], @heap[i]
      i /= 2
    end
  end

  def << key
    push key,key
  end

  def empty?
    @heap.empty?
  end

  def size
    @heap.size
  end
end

class PopHeap
  attr_accessor :nodes, :size
  def initialize(n)
    @nodes = Array.new(n)
    @size = 0
  end

  def push(x)
    current_index = @size
    @size += 1
    while current_index > 0 do
      parent_index = (current_index - 1)>>1
      parent_value = @nodes[parent_index]
      break if parent_value <= x
      @nodes[current_index] = parent_value
      current_index = parent_index
    end
    @nodes[current_index] = x
  end

  def pop
    top = @nodes[0]
    current_node_index = 0
    current_node_value = @nodes[0] = @nodes[@size - 1]
    @nodes[@size - 1] = nil
    @size -= 1

    while
      child_node_index_r = (current_node_index + 1) << 1
      child_node_index_l = child_node_index_r - 1
      return top unless child_node_index_l < @size
      child_node_value_l = @nodes[child_node_index_l]
      child_node_value_r = @nodes[child_node_index_r]
      if child_node_value_r&.<child_node_value_l
        min_child_value = child_node_value_r
        min_child_index = child_node_index_r
      else
        min_child_value = child_node_value_l
        min_child_index = child_node_index_l
      end
      return top unless min_child_value < current_node_value
      change(current_node_index, min_child_index)
      current_node_index = min_child_index
    end
  end

  private

  def change(index_i, index_j)
    @nodes[index_i], @nodes[index_j] = @nodes[index_j], @nodes[index_i]
  end
end

class ReversePopHeap
  attr_accessor :nodes, :size
  def initialize(n)
    @nodes = Array.new(n)
    @size = 0
  end

  def push(x)
    current_index = @size
    @size += 1
    while current_index > 0 do
      parent_index = (current_index - 1)>>1
      parent_value = @nodes[parent_index]
      break if parent_value >= x
      @nodes[current_index] = parent_value
      current_index = parent_index
    end
    @nodes[current_index] = x
  end

  def pop
    top = @nodes[0]
    current_node_index = 0
    current_node_value = @nodes[0] = @nodes[@size - 1]
    @nodes[@size - 1] = nil
    @size -= 1

    while
      child_node_index_r = (current_node_index + 1) << 1
      child_node_index_l = child_node_index_r - 1
      return top unless child_node_index_l < @size
      child_node_value_l = @nodes[child_node_index_l]
      child_node_value_r = @nodes[child_node_index_r]
      if child_node_value_r&.>child_node_value_l
        max_child_value = child_node_value_r
        max_child_index = child_node_index_r
      else
        max_child_value = child_node_value_l
        max_child_index = child_node_index_l
      end
      return top unless max_child_value > current_node_value
      change(current_node_index, max_child_index)
      current_node_index = max_child_index
    end
  end

  private

  def change(index_i, index_j)
    @nodes[index_i], @nodes[index_j] = @nodes[index_j], @nodes[index_i]
  end
end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :elements
  
  def initialize(&block)
    @elements = []
    @cmp = block || lambda { |a, b| a <=> b }
  end
  
  def push(n)
    i = @elements.size
    while i > 0
      p = (i-1) / 2
      break if @elements[p] <= n
      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p
    end
    @elements[i] = n
    self
  end
  alias :<< :push
  
  def pop
    min = @elements[0]
    n   = @elements.pop
    unless @elements.empty?
      i = 0
      while i * 2 + 1 < @elements.size
        if @elements[i * 2 + 2].nil? or @elements[i * 2 + 1] < @elements[i * 2 + 2]
          buf = i * 2 + 1
        else
          buf = i * 2 + 2
        end
        break if @elements[buf] > n
        @elements[i] = @elements[buf]
        i = buf
      end
      @elements[i] = n
    end
    min
  end
end

class Heap
  def initialize
    @a = []
    @sum = 0
  end
  attr_reader :sum

  def size
    @a.size
  end

  def push(x)
    @sum += x
    i = size
    while i > 0 do
      p = (i - 1) / 2
      break if @a[p] <= x
      @a[i] = @a[p]
      i = p
    end
    @a[i] = x
    self
  end

  # 最小の要素を取り出して返す
  def pop
    return nil if size == 0
    newsize = size - 1
    ret = @a.first
    x = @a.last
    i = 0
    while i * 2 + 1 < newsize do
      a = i * 2 + 1
      b = a + 1
      if b < newsize && @a[b] < @a[a]
        a = b
      end
      break if @a[a] >= x
      @a[i] = @a[a]
      i = a
    end
    @a[i] = x
    @a.pop
    @sum -= ret
    return ret
  end
end

def f(a)
  n = a.size/3
  car, mid, cdr = a.each_slice(n).to_a
  car.sort!
  cdr.sort!.reverse!
  _sum = car.inject(0,:+) - cdr.inject(0, :+)
  (0..n).map{|border|
    sum = _sum
    ii = 0
    iii = 0
    mid.each_with_index{|v, i|
      if i < border
        sub = v - car[ii]
        if sub > 0
          sum += sub
          ii += 1
        end
      else
        sub = cdr[iii] - v
        if sub > 0
          sum += sub
          iii += 1
        end
      end
    }
    sum
  }.max
end

class Heap
  attr_reader :size

  def initialize(order: :asc)
    @size = 0
    @heap = []
  end

  def empty?
    @size.zero?
  end

  def push(val)
    index = size
    @size += 1

    while index > 0
      parent = (index - 1) / 2

      break if @heap[parent] <= val

      @heap[index] = @heap[parent]
      index = parent
    end

    @heap[index] = val
  end

  alias_method :<<, :push

  def pop
    val = @heap.first
    root = @heap[size - 1]
    @size -= 1
    index = 0

    while index * 2 + 1 < @size
      left = 2 * index + 1
      right = left + 1

      if right < size && @heap[right] < @heap[left]
        left = right
      end

      break if @heap[left] >= root

      @heap[index] = @heap[left]
      index = left
    end

    @heap[index] = root
    val
  end

  def top
    @heap.first
  end
end

def former_array(a, half)
  a[0..(half - 1)]
end

def latter_array(a, half)
  a[half..-1]
end

def former_min_index(a)
  half = (a.size.to_f/2).ceil
  a1 = former_array(a, half)
  a1.index(a1.min)
end

def latter_max_index(a)
  half = (a.size.to_f/2).floor
  a2 = latter_array(a, half)
  a2.index(a2.max) + half
end

def score(a)
  sum = 0
  half_size = a.size / 2
  a.each_with_index do |v, i|
    if i < half_size
      sum += v
    else
      sum -= v
    end
  end
  sum
end

def dup_delete(a, i)
  da = a.dup
  da.delete_at(i)
  da
end

@candidates = []

def cut(a)
  if a.size == N * 2
    @candidates << score(a)
    return
  end

  if (a.size - 1) % 2 == 0
    # 1個抜きの2パターンのうちスコアが高い方を選択
    a1 = dup_delete(a, former_min_index(a))
    a2 = dup_delete(a, latter_max_index(a))
    next_a = [a1, a2].uniq
    next_a.each do |i|
      cut(i)
    end
  else
    # 2個抜きの4パターンのうちスコアが高いものを選択
    a1 = dup_delete(a, former_min_index(a))
    a2 = dup_delete(a, latter_max_index(a))
    a11 = dup_delete(a1, former_min_index(a1))
    a12 = dup_delete(a1, latter_max_index(a1))
    a21 = dup_delete(a2, former_min_index(a2))
    a22 = dup_delete(a2, latter_max_index(a2))

    next_a = [a11, a12, a21, a22].uniq
    next_a.each do |i|
      cut(i)
    end
  end
end

class Heap
  attr_accessor :data, :size

  def initialize
    @data=[]
  end

  def push(e)
    @data.push(e)

    cur = @data.size-1
    return if cur.zero?
    parent_i = parent(cur)

    while cur > 0 && @data[cur] < @data[parent_i]
      parent = @data[parent_i]
      @data[parent_i] = e
      @data[cur] = parent
      cur = parent_i
      parent_i = parent(cur)
    end
  end

  def pop
    ret = data.first
    last = data.last
    cur = 0
    while left_i(cur) < data.size
      li = left_i(cur)
      l = data[li]
      ri = right_i(cur)
      r = data[ri]

      ni=li
      ni = ri if ri < data.size && r < l

      break if data[ni] >= last

      data[cur] = data[ni]
      cur = ni
    end

    data[cur]=last
    data.pop

    ret
  end

  def left_i(i)
    2*i+1
  end

  def right_i(i)
    2*i+2
  end

  def parent(i)
    return 0 if i.zero?
    (i-1)/2
  end
end

class Heap
  attr_accessor :data, :size

  def initialize
    @data=[]
  end

  def push(e)
    @data.push(e)

    cur = @data.size-1
    return if cur.zero?
    parent_i = parent(cur)

    while cur > 0 && @data[cur] < @data[parent_i]
      parent = @data[parent_i]
      @data[parent_i] = e
      @data[cur] = parent
      cur = parent_i
      parent_i = parent(cur)
    end
  end

  def pop
    ret = @data.first
    last = data.last

    cur = 0
    while left_i(cur)<data.size
      li = left_i(cur)
      ri = right_i(cur)
      l=data[li]
      r=data[ri]
      ni=li
      ni=ri if r && r < l

      break if @data[ni] >= last

      @data[cur] = @data[ni]
      cur = ni
    end

    data[cur]=last
    data.pop

    ret
  end

  def left_i(i)
    2*i+1
  end

  def right_i(i)
    2*i+2
  end

  def parent(i)
    return 0 if i.zero?
    (i-1)/2
  end
end

class BH < Heap
  def push(e)
    @data.push(e)

    cur = @data.size-1
    return if cur.zero?
    parent_i = parent(cur)

    while cur > 0 && @data[cur] > @data[parent_i]
      parent = @data[parent_i]
      @data[parent_i] = e
      @data[cur] = parent
      cur = parent_i
      parent_i = parent(cur)
    end
  end

  def pop
    ret = @data.first
    last = data.last

    cur = 0
    while left_i(cur)<data.size
      li = left_i(cur)
      ri = right_i(cur)
      l=data[li]
      r=data[ri]
      ni=li
      ni=ri if r && r > l

      break if @data[ni] <= last

      @data[cur] = @data[ni]
      cur = ni
    end

    data[cur]=last
    data.pop

    ret
  end

end

  attr_reader :elements, :cmp
  
  def initialize(&block)

      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p
    end
    @elements[i] = n

    min
  end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :size

  def initialize(order: :asc)
    @size = 0
    @nodes = []
    @operator = (order == :asc) ? [:>, :<] : [:<, :>]
  end

  def empty?
    @size.zero?
  end

  def push(node)
    if @nodes[0].nil?
      @nodes[0] = node
    else
      index = size
      @nodes[index] = node

      loop {
        parent = (index - 1) / 2

        if (@nodes[parent].last <=> node.last).public_send(@operator.first, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[parent] = @nodes[parent], @nodes[index]
          index = parent

          break if index.zero?
        else
          break
        end
      }
    end

    @size += 1
  end

  alias_method :<<, :push

  def pop
    node = @nodes.first
    @nodes[0], @nodes[size - 1] = @nodes[size - 1], nil
    index = 0

    loop {
      left = 2 * index + 1
      right = 2 * index + 2

      target = if @nodes[left] && @nodes[right]
                 (@nodes[left].last <=> @nodes[right].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0) ? left : right
               elsif @nodes[left]
                 left
               elsif @nodes[right]
                 right
               else
                 nil
               end

      break if target.nil?

      if (@nodes[target].last <=> @nodes[index].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0)
        @nodes[index], @nodes[target] = @nodes[target], @nodes[index]
        index = target
      else
        break
      end
    }

    @size -= 1
    node.first
  end

  def top
    @nodes.first
  end
end

            i = p

        @heap[i] = x
        self

            break if @heap[a] >= x

            i = a
        end
        @heap[i] = x
        @heap.pop
        return ret
    end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :elements, :cmp
  
  def initialize(&block)
    @elements = []
    @cmp = block || lambda { |a, b| a <=> b }
  end
  
  def push(n)
    i = @elements.size
    while i > 0
      p = (i-1) / 2
      break if @cmp.call(@elements[p], n) <= 0
      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p
    end
    @elements[i] = n
    self
  end
  alias :<< :push
  
  def pop
    min = @elements[0]
    n   = @elements.pop
    unless @elements.empty?
      i = 0
      while i * 2 + 1 < @elements.size
        if @elements[i * 2 + 2].nil? or @cmp.call(@elements[i * 2 + 1], @elements[i * 2 + 2]) < 0
          buf = i * 2 + 1
        else
          buf = i * 2 + 2
        end
        break if @cmp.call(@elements[buf], n) >= 0
        @elements[i] = @elements[buf]
        i = buf
      end
      @elements[i] = n
    end
    min
  end
end

  end

class Heap
    attr_reader :size
    def initialize
        @heap = []
        @size = 0
    end

    def push(x)
        i = @size
        @size += 1
        while i > 0 do
            p = (i - 1) / 2
            break if @heap[p] <= x
            @heap[i] = @heap[p]
            i = p
        end
        @heap[i] = x
        self
    end

    def pop
        return nil if @size == 0
        ret = @heap[0]
        @size -= 1
        x = @heap[@size]
        i = 0
        while i * 2 + 1 < @size do
            a = i * 2 + 1
            b = a + 1
            if b < @size && @heap[b] < @heap[a]
                a = b
            end
            break if @heap[a] >= x
            @heap[i] = @heap[a]
            i = a
        end
        @heap[i] = x
        @heap.pop
        return ret
    end
end

      @ar[i] = @ar[parent]
      i = parent
    end
    @ar[i] = x

      break if @ar[a] >= x
      @ar[i] = @ar[a]
      i = a
    end
    @ar[i] = x
    ans
  end

# from: https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/3.6/Lib/heapq.py
class PQ
  attr_reader :heap, :sum

  def initialize(a)
    @heap = a.dup
    @sum = @heap.inject(0,:+)
    (@heap.size/2).downto(0){|i|
      sift_up(i)
    }
  end

  def sift_up(pos)
    last = @heap.size
    start = pos
    new_item = @heap[start]
    child = pos * 2 + 1
    while child < last
      right = child + 1
      child = right if right < last && @heap[child] >= @heap[right]
      @heap[pos] = @heap[child]
      pos = child
      child = pos * 2 + 1
    end
    @heap[pos] = new_item
    sift_down(start, pos)
  end

  def sift_down(start, pos)
    new_item = @heap[pos]
    while pos > start
      parent = (pos - 1) / 2
      parent_item = @heap[parent]
      break if new_item >= parent_item
      @heap[pos] = parent_item
      pos = parent
    end
    @heap[pos] = new_item
  end

  def [](i)
    @heap[i]
  end

  def to_a
    @heap
  end

  def empty?
    @heap.empty?
  end

  def push(item)
    @heap << item
    @sum += item
    sift_down(0, @heap.size-1)
    self
  end

  def <<(item)
    push(item)
  end

  def pop
    last_item = @heap.pop
    if @heap.empty?
      @sum -= last_item if last_item
      return last_item
    end
    res = @heap[0]
    @heap[0] = last_item
    sift_up(0)
    @sum -= res
    res
  end

  def push_pop(item)
    if @heap[0] < item
      @sum += item - heap[0]
      item, heap[0] = heap[0], item
      sift_up(0)
    end
    item
  end
end

class PriorityQueue
	class Node
		attr_reader :value, :priority
		def initialize(value, priority)
			@value = value
			@priority = priority
		end
	end

	def initialize
		@heap = [nil]
	end

	def size
		@heap.size - 1
	end

	def empty?
		size == 0
	end

	def peek
		@heap[1].value
	end

	def enqueue(value, priority)
		@heap.push(Node.new(value, priority))
		up_heap
		self
	end

	def dequeue
		return nil if empty?
		return @heap.pop.value if size == 1
		ret = @heap[1].value
		@heap[1] = @heap.pop
		down_heap
		ret
	end

	private

	def up_heap
		pos = size
		while pos > 1
			parent = pos / 2
			break if @heap[pos].priority <= @heap[parent].priority
			tmp = @heap[pos]
			@heap[pos] = @heap[parent]
			@heap[parent] = tmp
			pos = parent
		end
	end

	def down_heap
		pos = 1
		loop{
			left = pos * 2 
			right = pos * 2 + 1
			break if left >= @heap.size
			if right >= @heap.size || @heap[left].priority >= @heap[right].priority
				break if @heap[pos].priority >= @heap[left].priority
				tmp = @heap[pos]
				@heap[pos] = @heap[left]
				@heap[left] = tmp
				pos = left
			else
				break if @heap[pos].priority >= @heap[right].priority
				tmp = @heap[pos]
				@heap[pos] = @heap[right]
				@heap[right] = tmp
				pos = right
			end
		}
	end
end

def outxs(head)
  return [] if !head
    [head[:v]] + outxs(head[:next])
end

def r(xs, m)
  n = xs.size

  llist = xs.map.with_index{ |v,i| { v:v, i:i } }


  sorted_list = llist.sort_by{ |e| e[:v] }.each_with_index{ |e,s| e[:s] = s }

  (1...xs.size).each{ |i|
    sorted_list[i][:prev] = sorted_list[i-1]
    sorted_list[i-1][:next] = sorted_list[i]
  }


  cumm = sorted_list[0,m].map{ |e| e[:v] }.inject(:+)

  on_border = sorted_list[m-1]
  head = sorted_list[0]


  ans = [cumm]
  llist[0,n-m].each { |e|

    if e[:s] <= on_border[:s]
      on_border = on_border[:next]
      cumm += on_border[:v] - e[:v]
    end

    pv, nx = e[:prev], e[:next]
    (pv[:next] = nx) if pv
    (nx[:prev] = pv) if nx
    e[:prev] = nil
    e[:next] = nil

    (head = nx) if head == e

    ans << cumm
  }
  ans
end

          @ar[i] = @ar[parent]
          i = parent

          break unless @ar[a] #{opr} x
          @ar[i] = @ar[a]
          i = a
        end
        @ar[i] = x
        ans
      end
    }
  end

class PQueue
  def initialize(n, opr)
    @ar = Array.new(n)
    @opr = opr
    @c = 0
  end
 
  def push(x)
    i = @c
    @c += 1
    while (i > 0)
      parent = (i - 1) / 2
      break unless x.send(@opr, @ar[parent])
      @ar[i] = @ar[parent]
      i = parent
    end
    @ar[i] = x
  end
 
  def pop
    ans = @ar[0]
    @c -= 1
    x = @ar[@c]
    i = 0
    while (i * 2 + 1 < @c)
      a = i * 2 + 1
      b = a + 1
      a = b if b < @c && @ar[b].send(@opr, @ar[a])
      break unless @ar[a].send(@opr, x)
      @ar[i] = @ar[a]
      i = a
    end
    @ar[i] = x
    ans
  end

  def first
    @ar[0]
  end
end

class Heap
  attr_accessor :data, :size

  def initialize
    @data=[]
  end

  def comp(l, r)
    l > r
  end

  def push(e)
    @data.push(e)

    cur = @data.size-1
    return if cur.zero?
    parent_i = parent(cur)

    while cur > 0 && comp(@data[parent_i], e)
      parent = @data[parent_i]
      @data[parent_i] = e
      @data[cur] = parent
      cur = parent_i
      parent_i = parent(cur)
    end
  end

  def pop
    ret = @data.first
    last = data.last

    cur = 0
    while left_i(cur)<data.size
      li = left_i(cur)
      ri = right_i(cur)
      l=data[li]
      r=data[ri]
      ni=li
      ni=ri if r && comp(l, r)

      break if @data[ni] >= last

      @data[cur] = @data[ni]
      cur = ni
    end

    data[cur]=last
    data.pop

    ret
  end

  def left_i(i)
    2*i+1
  end

  def right_i(i)
    2*i+2
  end

  def parent(i)
    return 0 if i.zero?
    (i-1)/2
  end
end

class BH < Heap
  def comp(l,r)
    r > l
  end
end

def nibutan(arr,max,min,key)
	if max < min
		return min
	else
		mid = min+(max-min)/2
		if arr[mid] > key
			nibutan(arr,mid-1,min,key)
		elsif arr[mid] < key
			nibutan(arr,max,mid+1,key)
		else
			return mid
		end
	end
end

let () =

  let a = Array.init (3*n) (fun _ -> Scanf.scanf " %d" ((+) 0)) in

  let s1 = for_fold 0 n (fun s i -> s + a.(i)) 0 in
  let st1 = for_fold 0 n (fun st i -> S.add (a.(i), i) st) S.empty in

  let s2 = for_fold (2*n) (3*n) (fun s i -> s + a.(i)) 0 in
  let st2 = for_fold (2*n) (3*n) (fun st i -> S.add (a.(i), i) st) S.empty in

    let st' = S.add (a.(i), i) st in
    let le, j = S.min_elt st' in
    let st'' = S.add (a.(i),i) st' |> S.remove (le, j) in
    let m' = m + (a.(i) - le) in
    (m', m'::ac, st'')) (s1, [s1], st1)
    |> fun (_,l,_) -> List.rev l
  in

    let i = 2*n - 1 - i' in

    let ma, j = S.max_elt st' in
    let st'' = S.add (a.(i),i) st' |> S.remove (ma, j) in
    let m' = m + (a.(i) - ma) in
    (m', m'::ac, st'')) (s2, [s2], st2)

type PriorityQueue[T] = object
  data:seq[T]
  comp:proc(x,y:T):int
proc initPriorityQueue[T]():PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:system.cmp[T])
proc initPriorityQueue[T](comp:proc(x,y:T):int):PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:comp)
proc `[]`[T](q: PriorityQueue[T], n: int): T = q.data[n]
proc `[]=`[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], n: int, item: T) = q.data[n] = item
proc len[T](q:PriorityQueue[T]): int = len(q.data)
proc shiftup[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx:int) =
  var i = idx
  while i != 0:
    let p = (i - 1) shr 1
    if q.comp(q[i], q[p]) >= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[i], q.data[p])
    i = p
proc shiftdown[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx: int) =
  var i = idx
  let n = len(q)
  while 2*i + 1 < n:
    var
      a = 2*i + 1
      b = 2*i + 2
    if b < n and q.comp(q[a], q[b]) > 0:
      a = b
    if q.comp(q[i], q[a]) <= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[a], q.data[i])
    i = a
proc push[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], item: T) =
  let n = len(q)
  q.data.add(item)
  shiftup(q, n)
proc pop[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  let n = len(q)
  result = q[0]
  q[0] = q.data.pop
  shiftdown(q, 0)

import sys
fin = sys.stdin.readline
from heapq import heappop, heappush, heapify

N = int(fin())
a_list = [int(elem) for elem in fin().split()]
left, right = a_list[:N], a_list[N:]

thrown_away = [False] * (2 * N)
discarded_items = []

# initialize
right_sum = sum(right)
for i, item in enumerate(right):
    if i < N:
        heappush(discarded_items, (item, i))
        thrown_away[i] = True
        right_sum -= item
    else:
        if item > discarded_items[0][0]:
            old_item, old_idx = heappop(discarded_items)
            thrown_away[old_idx] = False
            heappush(discarded_items, (item, i))
            thrown_away[i] = True
            right_sum += old_item - item


# move partitions and calculate a global maximum
left_sum = sum(left)
heapify(left)
# dirty trick
thrown_away.append(False)
max_score = left_sum - right_sum
for i, item in enumerate(right[:N]):
    if not thrown_away[i]:
        # update right
        updated_idx = -1
        # pick a item which has not moved to the left.
        while thrown_away[updated_idx] == False:
            updated_item, updated_idx = heappop(discarded_items)
        right_sum += updated_item - item
        thrown_away[updated_idx] = False
    else:
        # want to remove item from discarded_items, but it take O(N)
        # instead, set thrown_away[i] = False so as to know this is moved to the left.
        thrown_away[i] = False
    # update left
    if item > left[0]:
        old_item = heappop(left)
        heappush(left, item)
        left_sum += item - old_item
    max_score = max(max_score, left_sum - right_sum)

print(max_score)

leftQ = As[:N]
rightQ = minusAs[-N:]
heapq.heapify(leftQ)
heapq.heapify(rightQ)

#この配列のidxは、右端（左端）から何番目(0スタート)の区切りを採用するかを表す。あとで突き合わせる時に添字でバグらせないよう注意
leftsum = [0]*(N+1)
rightsum = [0]*(N+1) #どうせ最後に引くんだから、マイナスのまま入れちゃう
#つまり、最後に最小値を求める時は、逆に「最も大きい＝マイナス幅が小さいsum」を求めることになるので注意

#初期値はもう入れておく
leftsum[0] = sum(leftQ)
rightsum[0] = sum(rightQ)

for i in range(N, 2*N): #左端（右端）から最低N個（N-1まで）は済んでいる。残りはNまで～2N-1まで)

  #iが2Nのとき、左側は[0:2N], 右側は[-2N:]
  if leftQ[0] < As[i]: #大きいのを残したいので、最小値のが小さければ入れ替える
    #入れ替える
    nowmin = heapq.heappop(leftQ)

    heapq.heappush(leftQ,As[i])
  else: leftsum[i-N+1] = leftsum[i-N] #そうでなければ入れ替えない
  if rightQ[0] < minusAs[-1-i]: #小さいのを残したいので、マイナス幅が大きければ入れ替える
    nowmax = heapq.heappop(rightQ)
    rightsum[i-N+1] = rightsum[i-N] - nowmax + minusAs[-1-i]
    heapq.heappush(rightQ,minusAs[-1-i])
  else: rightsum[i-N+1] = rightsum[i-N] #そうでなければ入れ替えない

def abc062_d():
    n = int(input())
    A = list(map(int, input().split()))

    front = A[:n]
    fsum = [0] * (3*n)
    fsum[n-1] = sum(front)
    heapify(front)
    for i in range(n, 2*n):
        fmin = heappushpop(front, A[i])
        fsum[i] = fsum[i-1] + A[i] - fmin

    back = [-1*a for a in A[2*n:]]
    bsum = [0] * (3*n)
    bsum[2*n] = -1 * sum(back)
    heapify(back)
    for i in range(2*n-1, n-1, -1):
        bmax = -1 * heappushpop(back, -1*A[i])
        bsum[i] = bsum[i+1] + A[i] - bmax

    ans = -10**18
    for i in range(n-1, 2*n):
        ans = max(ans, fsum[i] - bsum[i+1])
    print(ans)

from heapq import heappush, heappushpop

N = int(input())
aN = list(map(int, input().split()))

mids = aN[N:N*2]
L = []
R = []
for i in range(N):
    # とりあえず前後半確定の部分をキューに詰める
    heappush(L, aN[i])
    heappush(R, -aN[i+N*2])

# 未確定の真ん中1/3について調べていく
l_sum = [0] * (N+1)
l_sum[0] = sum(aN[:N])
for i in range(N):
    # ある値をpushして最小値をpopする
    num = heappushpop(L, mids[i])
    # それに合わせて合計値も更新
    l_sum[i+1] = l_sum[i] + mids[i] - num

# 後半部分は逆方向からやる
r_sum = [0] * (N+1)
r_sum[N] = sum(aN[N*2:])
for i in range(N-1, -1, -1):
    # 正負逆転させれば最大値にも使える
    num = -(heappushpop(R, -mids[i]))
    r_sum[i] = r_sum[i+1] + mids[i] - num

ans = -float('inf')
for i in range(N+1):
    ans = max(l_sum[i] - r_sum[i], ans)
print(ans)

def solve(A, N):
    red_pq = []
    blue_pq = []

    for a in A[:N]:
        heappush(red_pq, a)
    red_total = sum(A[:N])

    best_ans = float('-inf')
    for k in range(N, 2*N):

        temp = A[k+1:]
        temp.sort()
        blue_total = sum(temp[:N])

        best_ans = max(best_ans, ans)

def d_3n_numbers(N, A):
    import heapq
    left = A[:N]
    heapq.heapify(left)
    # heappopはキューの最小値を取り出すが、rightからは最大値を取り出したいので-1を掛ける
    # 後にマイナスが付いているところは、それの帳尻を合わせている
    right = [-i for i in A[2 * N:]]
    heapq.heapify(right)

    # 最初、leftには数列の先頭N個が、rightには末尾N個が格納されている
    # 数列のN番目から2N番目まで順に、leftに格納して最小値を捨てることを繰り返す
    # 数列の2N番目からN番目まで順に、rightに格納して最大値を捨てることを繰り返す
    left_sum = [sum(left)]
    right_sum = [-sum(right)]
    for k in range(N, 2 * N):
        heapq.heappush(left, A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(left)
        left_sum.append(left_sum[-1] + A[k] - v)
    for k in range(2 * N - 1, N - 1, -1):
        heapq.heappush(right, -A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(right)
        right_sum.append(right_sum[-1] + A[k] - (-v))

    score = [a - b for a, b in zip(left_sum, right_sum[::-1])]
    return max(score)

def minus(n):

def solve(N: int, a: "List[int]"):
    ## N+iまでのリストの大きい順のNコのわ  
    left_sum = [0]*(N+1)
    heap = a[:N]
    left_sum[0] = sum(heap)
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    for i in range(N,2*N):
        heapq.heappush(heap,a[i])
        min_value = heapq.heappop(heap)
        left_sum[i-(N-1)]=left_sum[i-N]+a[i]-min_value

    b = list(map(minus,reversed(a)))
    right_sum= [0]*(N+1)
    r_heap = b[:N]
    right_sum[0] = -sum(r_heap)
    heapq.heapify(r_heap)
    for i in range(N,2*N):

import heapq


def solve(n):
  a = list(map(int,input().split()))
  # 左半分を計算して右端[n+idx]でメモ
  # 左半分は最大化したいので最小値が初めに出てくるようにする
  leftHsum = [0 for i in range(n+1)]
  leftH = a[0:n]
  heapq.heapify(leftH)
  leftHsum[0] = sum(leftH) # 
  for i in range(n):
    if leftH[0] < a[n+i]:
      leftHsum[i+1] = leftHsum[i] - leftH[0] + a[n+i]
      heapq.heappop(leftH)
      heapq.heappush(leftH, a[n+i])
    else:
      leftHsum[i+1] = leftHsum[i]
  # 右半分は負の値で保持する
  # もっとも大きい値から追い出していく
  rightHsum = [0 for i in range(n+1)]
  rightH = list(map(lambda x: -x,a[2*n:3*n]))
  heapq.heapify(rightH)
  rightHsum[0] = - sum(rightH)
  for i in range(n):
    if rightH[0] < -a[2*n-i-1]:
      rightHsum[i+1] = rightHsum[i] + rightH[0] + a[2*n-i-1]
      heapq.heappop(rightH)
      heapq.heappush(rightH, -a[2*n-i-1])
    else:
      rightHsum[i+1] = rightHsum[i]
  result = -1000000000000000000
  #print(leftHsum)
  #print(rightHsum)
  for i in range(n):
    result = max(result, leftHsum[0+i]-rightHsum[n-i])
  return result

def main():

    data = list(map(int, input().split()))

    left_heap = []
    left_sum = 0
    for i in range(num):
        left_sum += data[i]
        heapq.heappush(left_heap, data[i])

    dp_left = [0 for i in range(num + 1)]
    dp_left[0] = left_sum

    for i in range(num):
        now_num = data[num + i]
        pop_data = heapq.heappushpop(left_heap, now_num)
        left_sum += now_num - pop_data
        dp_left[i + 1] = left_sum

    right_heap = []
    right_sum = 0
    for i in range(num):
        right_sum += data[3 * num - 1 - i]
        heapq.heappush(right_heap, -data[3 * num - 1 - i])

    for i in range(num):
        now_num = data[2 * num - 1 - i]
        pop_data = heapq.heappushpop(right_heap, -now_num)
        right_sum += now_num + pop_data
        dp_right[i + 1] = right_sum
    dp_right = dp_right[::-1]

    ans = -2 * 10 ** 10
    for i in range(num + 1):
        ans = max(ans, dp_left[i] - dp_right[i])

def solve():
  n = int(raw_input())
  ar = raw_input().split(' ')
  iar = [int(s) for s in ar]
  
  early = iar[:n]
  mid = iar[n:-n]
  late = iar[-n:]

  heapq.heapify(early)
  tmpsum = sum(early)
  esums = [tmpsum]
  for i in range(n):
    heapq.heappush(early, mid[i])
    emin = heapq.heappop(early)
    tmpsum += (mid[i] - emin)
    esums.append(tmpsum)
  #print esums
 
  lateinv = [-x for x in late]
  heapq.heapify(lateinv)
  tmpsum = sum(lateinv)
  lsums = [tmpsum]
  for i in range(1,n+1):
    heapq.heappush(lateinv, -mid[-i])
    lmax = heapq.heappop(lateinv)
    tmpsum += (-mid[-i] - lmax)
    lsums.append(tmpsum)
  #print lsums
  
  best = float("-inf")
  for i in range(n+1):
    score = esums[i] + lsums[n-i]
    #print 'i=',i,',n-i=',n-i,',esums[i]=',esums[i],',lsums[n-i]=',lsums[n-i],'score=',score
    if(best < score) : best = score
  return best

def d_3N_Numbers(N, A):
    if N % 2 == 0:
        # 数列Aを半分に割ったときの「左半分」と「右半分」に分ける
        left = A[:3 * N // 2]
        right = A[3 * N // 2:]
        # スコアを最大にするため、このようにソートしておく
        left = sorted(left, reverse=True)
        right = sorted(right)
    else:
        from bisect import insort
        left = A[:3 * N // 2]
        right = A[3 * N // 2 + 1:]
        mid = A[3 * N // 2]
        left = sorted(left)
        right = sorted(right)
        # 中央の要素を左半分と右半分のどちらに入れるか決める
        if min(left) <= mid:
            insort(left, mid)
        elif min(left) > mid:
            insort(right, mid)
        left = left[::-1]

    # 左半分から大きいものをN個、右半分からは小さいものをN個取る
    first_half = left[:N]
    second_half = right[:N]
    ans = sum(first_half) - sum(second_half)  # スコアの計算
    return ans

import sys
from sys import stdin
from heapq import heappop, heappush
input = stdin.readline


def solve(A, N):
    red_pq = []
    blue_pq = []

    for a in A[:N]:
        heappush(red_pq, a)
    red_total = sum(A[:N])

    blue_total = 0
    for a in A[2*N:]:
        heappush(blue_pq, -a)
        blue_total += a

    blue_lut = [0] * (3*N)
    blue_lut[2*N] = blue_total
    for k in range(2*N - 1, N - 1, -1):
        t1 = A[k]
        heappush(blue_pq, -t1)
        t2 = heappop(blue_pq)
        blue_total += (t1 + t2)
        blue_lut[k] = blue_total

    best_ans = red_total - blue_total

    for k in range(N, 2*N):
        t1 = A[k]
        heappush(red_pq, t1)
        t2 = heappop(red_pq)
        red_total += (t1 - t2)

        ans = red_total - blue_lut[k+1]
        best_ans = max(best_ans, ans)

    return best_ans


def main(args):
    N = int(input())
    A = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
    result = solve(A, N)
    print(result)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])

import heapq


def solve(n):
  a = list(map(int,input().split()))
  # 左半分を計算して右端[n+idx]でメモ
  # 左半分は最大化したいので最小値が初めに出てくるようにする
  leftHsum = [0 for i in range(n+1)]
  leftH = a[0:n]
  heapq.heapify(leftH)
  leftHsum[0] = sum(leftH) # 
  for i in range(n):
    if leftH[0] < a[n+i]:
      leftHsum[i+1] = leftHsum[i] - leftH[0] + a[n+i]
      heapq.heappop(leftH)
      heapq.heappush(leftH, a[n+i])
    else:
      leftHsum[i+1] = leftHsum[i]
  # 右半分は負の値で保持する
  # もっとも大きい値から追い出していく
  rightHsum = [0 for i in range(n+1)]
  rightH = list(map(lambda x: -x,a[2*n:3*n]))
  heapq.heapify(rightH)
  rightHsum[0] = - sum(rightH)
  for i in range(n):
    if rightH[0] < -a[2*n-i-1]:
      rightHsum[i+1] = rightHsum[i] + rightH[0] + a[2*n-i-1]
      heapq.heappop(rightH)
      heapq.heappush(rightH, -a[2*n-i-1])
    else:
      rightHsum[i+1] = rightHsum[i]
  result = -1000000000000000000
  #print(leftHsum)
  #print(rightHsum)
  for i in range(n+1):
    result = max(result, leftHsum[0+i]-rightHsum[n-i])
  return result

    if i < N:
        heappush(discarded_items, (item, i))
        thrown_away[i] = True
        right_sum -= item
    else:
        if item > discarded_items[0][0]:
            old_item, old_idx = heappop(discarded_items)
            thrown_away[old_idx] = False
            heappush(discarded_items, (item, i))
            thrown_away[i] = True
            right_sum += old_item - item


# move partitions and calculate a global maximum
left_sum = sum(left)
heapify(left)
# dirty trick
thrown_away.append(False)
max_score = left_sum - right_sum
for i, item in enumerate(right[:N]):
    if not thrown_away[i]:
        # update right
        updated_idx = -1
        # pick a item which has not moved to the left.
        while thrown_away[updated_idx] == False:
            updated_item, updated_idx = heappop(discarded_items)
        right_sum += updated_item - item
        thrown_away[updated_idx] = False
    else:

        thrown_away[i] = False
    # update left
    if item > left[0]:
        old_item = heappop(left)
        heappush(left, item)
        left_sum += item - old_item
    max_score = max(max_score, left_sum - right_sum)

ef d_3n_numbers(N, A):
    import heapq
 
    def _heappush_max(heap, item):
        heap.append(item)
        heapq._siftdown_max(heap, 0, len(heap) - 1)
    def _heappop_max(heap):
    """Maxheap version of a heappop."""
    　　lastelt = heap.pop()    # raises appropriate IndexError if heap is empty
    　　if heap:
        　　returnitem = heap[0]
        　　heap[0] = lastelt
        　　heapq._siftup_max(heap, 0)
        　　return returnitem
    　　return lastelt
    setattr(heapq, '_heappush_max', _heappush_max)
 
    left = A[:N]
    heapq.heapify(left)
    right = A[2 * N:]
    heapq._heapify_max(right)
    left_sum, right_sum = [sum(left)], [sum(right)]
 
    # 同じ要素をleftとrightで取り合っても、相殺されるので問題ない
    for k in range(N, 2 * N):
        heapq.heappush(left, A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(left)
        left_sum.append(left_sum[-1] + A[k] - v)
    for k in range(2 * N - 1, N - 1, -1):
        heapq._heappush_max(right, A[k])
        v = heapq._heappop_max(right)
        right_sum.append(right_sum[-1] + A[k] - v)
    right_sum = right_sum[::-1]
 
    ans_candidate = [a - b for a, b in zip(left_sum, right_sum)]
    return max(ans_candidate)

import heapq

class Heapq:
    def __init__(self, arr, desc=False):
        if desc:
            arr = [-a for a in arr]
        self.sign = -1 if desc else 1
        self.hq = arr
        heapq.heapify(self.hq)

    def pop(self):
        return heapq.heappop(self.hq) * self.sign

    def push(self, a):
        heapq.heappush(self.hq, a * self.sign)

    def top(self):
        return self.hq[0] * self.sign

def score(init, cand):
    
    score = [0] * (n+1)
    score[0] = sum(init)
    hp = init

            score[i+1] = score[i] + (ai - min_a)
            heapq.heappush(hp, ai)
        else:
            score[i+1] = score[i]
    
    return score

import heapq

def main():
    num = int(input())
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))

    left_heap = []
    left_sum = 0
    for i in range(num):
        left_sum += data[i]
        heapq.heappush(left_heap, data[i])

    dp_left = [0 for i in range(num + 1)]
    dp_left[0] = left_sum

    for i in range(num):
        now_num = data[num + i]
        pop_data = heapq.heappushpop(left_heap, now_num)
        left_sum += now_num - pop_data
        dp_left[i + 1] = left_sum

    right_heap = []
    right_sum = 0
    for i in range(num):
        right_sum += data[3 * num - 1 - i]
        heapq.heappush(right_heap, -data[3 * num - 1 - i])

    dp_right = [0 for i in range(num + 1)]
    dp_right[0] = right_sum

    for i in range(num):
        now_num = data[2 * num - 1 - i]
        pop_data = heapq.heappushpop(right_heap, -now_num)
        right_sum += now_num + pop_data
        dp_right[i + 1] = right_sum
    dp_right = dp_right[::-1]

    ans = dp_left[-1] - dp_right[-1]
    for i in range(num):
        ans = max(ans, dp_left[i] - dp_right[i])

    print(ans)

if __name__ == '__main__':

    heapify(res)

import sys
from itertools import accumulate
from heapq import heappush, heappop
def input(): return sys.stdin.readline().strip()


def main():
    N = int(input())
    A = [0] + list(map(int, input().split()))
    S = list(accumulate(A))

    # small[i] = A[1],A[2],...,A[N + i]から小さい順にi個選んだときの和
    small = [0] * (N + 1)
    q = []
    for i in range(1, N + 1): heappush(q, A[i])
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        heappush(q, A[N + i])
        v = heappop(q)
        small[i] = small[i - 1] + v

    # large[i] = A[3N],A[3N-1],...,A[2N+1-i]から大きい順にi個選んだときの和
    large = [0] * (N + 1)
    q = []
    for i in range(2 * N + 1, 3 * N + 1): heappush(q, -A[i])
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        heappush(q, -A[2 * N + 1 - i])
        v = -heappop(q)
        large[i] = large[i - 1] + v

    ans = -10**18
    for i in range(N, 2 * N + 1):
        """
        A[1],A[2],...,A[i]から小さい順に(i - N)個除いたものが前半
        A[i+1],A[i+2],...,A[3N]から大きい順に(2N - i)個除いたものが後半
        """
        pre = S[i] - small[i - N]
        post = (S[-1] - S[i]) - large[2 * N - i]
        ans = max(ans, pre - post)
    print(ans)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
from sys import stdin
from heapq import heappop, heappush
input = stdin.readline


def solve(A, N):
    red_pq = []
    blue_pq = []

    for a in A[:N]:
        heappush(red_pq, a)
    red_total = sum(A[:N])

    temp = A[N:]
    temp.sort()
    blue_total = sum(temp[:N])
    best_ans = red_total - blue_total


    for k in range(N, 2*N):
        t1 = A[k]
        heappush(red_pq, t1)
        t2 = heappop(red_pq)
        red_total += (t1 - t2)

        temp = A[k+1:]
        temp.sort()
        blue_total = sum(temp[:N])

        ans = red_total - blue_total
        best_ans = max(best_ans, ans)

    return best_ans


def main(args):
    N = int(input())
    A = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
    result = solve(A, N)
    print(result)

    main(sys.argv[1:])

def d_3N_Numbers(N, A):
    import heapq
    left = A[:N]
    heapq.heapify(left)
    # heappopがキューの最小値を取り出す一方、rightからは最大値を取り出してほしいので、
    # -1を掛ける
    right = [-i for i in A[2 * N:]]
    heapq.heapify(right)
    left_sum = [sum(left)]
    right_sum = [-sum(right)]  # 定義で-1を付けた都合上

    # 同じ要素をleftとrightで取り合っても、相殺されるので問題ない
    for k in range(N, 2 * N):
        heapq.heappush(left, A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(left)
        left_sum.append(left_sum[-1] + A[k] - v)
    for k in range(2 * N - 1, N - 1, -1):
        # -1をかけるのは、rightの定義の都合上
        heapq.heappush(right, -A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(right)
        right_sum.append(right_sum[-1] + A[k] - (-v))
    right_sum = right_sum[::-1]
    ans = []
    for a, b in zip(left_sum, right_sum):
        ans.append(a - b)
    return max(ans)

def d_3n_numbers(N, A):
    import heapq
    left = A[:N]
    heapq.heapify(left)
    # heappopはキューの最小値を取り出すが、rightからは最大値を取り出したいので-1を掛ける
    # 後にマイナスが付いているところは、それの帳尻を合わせている
    right = [-i for i in A[2 * N:]]
    heapq.heapify(right)

    # 最初、leftには数列の先頭N個が、rightには末尾N個が格納されている
    # 数列のN番目から2N番目まで順に、leftに格納して最小値を捨てることを繰り返す
    # 数列の2N番目からN番目まで順に、rightに格納して最大値を捨てることを繰り返す
    left_sum = [sum(left)]
    right_sum = [-sum(right)]
    for k in range(N, 2 * N):
        heapq.heappush(left, A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(left)
        left_sum.append(left_sum[-1] + A[k] - v)
    for k in range(2 * N - 1, N - 1, -1):
        heapq.heappush(right, -A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(right)
        right_sum.append(right_sum[-1] + A[k] - (-v))

    score = [a - b for a, b in zip(left_sum, right_sum[::-1])]
    return max(score)

def main():
    num = int(input())
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))

    left_data = data[:num]
    left_data.sort()
    left_sum = sum(left_data)

    dp_left = [0 for i in range(num + 1)]
    dp_left[0] = left_sum

    for i in range(num):
        now_num = data[num + i]
        pop_data = left_data[0]
        left_data.pop(0)
        bisect.insort_left(left_data, now_num)
        left_sum += now_num - pop_data
        dp_left[i + 1] = left_sum

    right_data = data[2 * num :]
    right_sum = sum(right_data)

    dp_right = [0 for i in range(num + 1)]
    dp_right[0] = right_sum

    for i in range(num):
        now_num = data[2 * num - 1 - i]
        pop_data = right_data[-1]
        right_data.pop(-1)
        bisect.insort_left(right_data, now_num)
        right_sum += now_num - pop_data
        dp_right[i + 1] = right_sum
    dp_right = dp_right[::-1]

    ans = dp_left[-1] - dp_right[-1]
    for i in range(num):
        ans = max(ans, dp_left[i] - dp_right[i])

    print(ans)

def LI_(): return [int(x)-1 for x in sys.stdin.readline().split()]

def LS(): return sys.stdin.readline().split()
def I(): return int(sys.stdin.readline())

def S(): return input()
     
def main():
    N = I()
    A = LI()
    wakeme = N
    Aleftsum = [0 for _ in range(3*N+1)]
    Arightsum = [0 for _ in range(3*N+1)]

    leftA = [x for x in A[:N]]
    rightA = [-x for x in A[-N:]]

    heapq.heapify(leftA)
    heapq.heapify(rightA)

    lsum = sum(leftA)
    rsum = sum(rightA)

    Aleftsum[wakeme] = lsum
    Arightsum[2*N] = -rsum

    # [0, N)から[0, 2N)までの和が欲しい
    # Aleftsum(i): [0, i)までの上位N個の和

    # [2N, 3N)から[N, 3N)までの和が欲しい
    # Arightsum(i): [i, 3N)までの上位N個の和

    for i in range(N):
        # [0, N+1)から[0, 2N)までやる。
        # [0, wakeme + i + 1)の和を計算する。
        # wakeme=Nなので、wakeme + i + 1 = 2N -> i = N - 1
        newl = A[wakeme + i]
        lsum += newl
        lsum -= heapq.heappushpop(leftA, newl)
        Aleftsum[wakeme+i+1] = lsum

        # [2N-1, 3N)から[N, 3N)までやる。
        # r_wakeme = 2N-1として、
        # r_wakeme - i = 2N - 1 -> i=0
        # r_wakeme - i = N -> i=N-1
        newr = A[2*N-1 - i]
        rsum -= newr
        rsum -= heapq.heappushpop(rightA, -newr)
        Arightsum[2*N-1 - i] = -rsum

    ans = -inf
    for i in range(N, 2*N+1):
        ans = max(ans, Aleftsum[i] - Arightsum[i])

    print(ans)
main()

    for _, i in AH[:N]:

            h += AH[hp][0]
            used[AH[hp][1]] = True

def d_3n_numbers(N, A):
    import heapq

    def _heappush_max(heap, item):
        heap.append(item)
        heapq._siftdown_max(heap, 0, len(heap) - 1)
    setattr(heapq, '_heappush_max', _heappush_max)

    left = A[:N]
    heapq.heapify(left)
    right = A[2 * N:]
    heapq._heapify_max(right)
    left_sum, right_sum = [sum(left)], [sum(right)]

    # 同じ要素をleftとrightで取り合っても、相殺されるので問題ない
    for k in range(N, 2 * N):
        heapq.heappush(left, A[k])
        v = heapq.heappop(left)
        left_sum.append(left_sum[-1] + A[k] - v)
    for k in range(2 * N - 1, N - 1, -1):
        heapq._heappush_max(right, A[k])
        v = heapq._heappop_max(right)
        right_sum.append(right_sum[-1] + A[k] - v)
    right_sum = right_sum[::-1]

    ans_candidate = [a - b for a, b in zip(left_sum, right_sum)]
    return max(ans_candidate)

kaijo_memo = []
def kaijo(n):
  if(len(kaijo_memo) > n): return kaijo_memo[n]
  if(len(kaijo_memo) == 0): kaijo_memo.append(1)
  while(len(kaijo_memo) <= n): kaijo_memo.append(kaijo_memo[-1] * len(kaijo_memo) % MOD)
  return kaijo_memo[n]

gyaku_kaijo_memo = []
def gyaku_kaijo(n):
  if(len(gyaku_kaijo_memo) > n): return gyaku_kaijo_memo[n]
  if(len(gyaku_kaijo_memo) == 0): gyaku_kaijo_memo.append(1)
  while(len(gyaku_kaijo_memo) <= n): gyaku_kaijo_memo.append(gyaku_kaijo_memo[-1] * pow(len(gyaku_kaijo_memo),MOD-2,MOD) % MOD)
  return gyaku_kaijo_memo[n]

def nCr(n,r):
  if n == r: return 1
  if n < r or r < 0: return 0
  ret = 1
  ret = ret * kaijo(n) % MOD
  ret = ret * gyaku_kaijo(r) % MOD
  ret = ret * gyaku_kaijo(n-r) % MOD
  return ret

def factorization(n):
  arr = []
  temp = n
  for i in range(2, int(-(-n**0.5//1))+1):
    if temp%i==0:
      cnt=0
      while temp%i==0: 
        cnt+=1 
        temp //= i
      arr.append([i, cnt])
  if temp!=1: arr.append([temp, 1])
  if arr==[]: arr.append([n, 1])
  return arr

def make_divisors(n):
  divisors = []
  for i in range(1, int(n**0.5)+1):
    if n % i == 0:
      divisors.append(i)
      if i != n // i: 
        divisors.append(n//i)
  return divisors

#####MakePrimes######
def make_primes(N):
  max = int(math.sqrt(N))
  seachList = [i for i in range(2,N+1)]
  primeNum = []
  while seachList[0] <= max:
    primeNum.append(seachList[0])
    tmp = seachList[0]
    seachList = [i for i in seachList if i % tmp != 0]

leftQ = As[:N]
rightQ = minusAs[-N:]

    heapq.heappush(rightQ,minusAs[-1-i])
  else: rightsum[i-N+1] = rightsum[i-N] #そうでなければ入れ替えない

    tmp.sort()
    latter_min_nth = [False] * 3 * n    # 0...n-1 は意味なし, 後半 n 要素で使っている奴らがメモられたリスト
    sub_member_r_h = []    # 現在後半 n 要素の控えメンバーたちが入った min heap

            assert (ind > i)
            right += num
            latter_min_nth[ind] = True
        max_score = max(max_score, left - right)
